names.name: CWSAgent – Web Store Listing Autofill & Extract
CWSAgent – Web Store Listing Export & Autofill

summaries: Fill and extract Chrome Web Store and Edge listings: descriptions, localized screenshots, promo tiles and privacy answers.
Autofill supported Chrome and Edge listing fields from a ZIP or folder. Review and save each draft yourself.
Load descriptions and localized screenshots from one package. Fill Chrome and Edge listing forms, then review your draft.
Export Chrome listing text and images to an editable package, then autofill supported store fields.
Keep localized descriptions and screenshots together. Import a listing package or connect ExtensionTower for Sync.
